name: safety-run-mascot-2d
style: flat 2D, same look as the game's vector mascot
view: From behind, like the game camera. The mascot runs away from the camera.
howToUse: Each animation is a grid sheet (row-major, frame size = cell). Place the sprite so `anchor` (the feet) sits on the ground point and scale by (game u in px) / unit. Squash, stretch, lean and cape flutter are already drawn into the frames: play them as they are, do not scale or rotate the sprite. Sprites are not trimmed.

idle.note: Standing and breathing; menu and the moment before the run starts.

run.note: Running away from the camera. One loop = two steps. Body bob, lean and cape flutter are drawn in.

jump.note: takeoff→rise while vy > 0, apex near vy = 0, fall while vy < 0 (hold the last fall frame), land plays on touchdown. The sprite already contains the squash and stretch; the game only moves it up and down.

slide.note: Tuck ball: curls into a round bundle with the head sunk into the cape, rocking gently
